headline: Akme Fintrade crosses Rs 1,000 crore AUM milestone with 35% growth
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited announced its Assets Under Management (AUM) crossed Rs 1,000 crore, recording a 35% year-on-year growth. For the first half of fiscal year 2027, the company reported a Profit After Tax (PAT) increase of 19% year-on-year. The milestone reflects steady expansion in the company's lending portfolio. Retail investors tracking small-cap non-banking financial companies can observe the pace of loan book scaling alongside profitability.
why_it_matters: Portfolio milestone signals steady scale for small-cap NBFC investors

headline: Akme Fintrade discloses related party transactions to the exchange
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited has submitted a disclosure regarding its related party transactions to the stock exchange. This is a standard corporate governance filing mandated by regulatory norms. Indian retail investors tracking small-cap financial firms monitor these filings for transparency on internal dealings. No financial figures or specific transaction details were highlighted in the brief notice.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate governance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: AfIL receives trading approval for 82 lakh preferential equity shares
hook: 82 lakh shares added to trading list
summary: Ashiana Housing has received formal trading approval from the exchange for 82,00,000 equity shares of Re 1 face value. These shares were allotted following the conversion of warrants issued on a preferential basis under SEBI regulations. This increases the total listed equity base of the company. Retail shareholders should note the minor equity dilution resulting from this conversion.
why_it_matters: Equity dilution from warrant conversion marginally alters your per-share value.

headline: Akme Fintrade allots 50,000 non-convertible debentures
hook: Akme Fintrade raises capital via debt
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited has allotted 50,000 non-convertible debentures (NCDs). The decision was finalized during the company's board meeting held on October 19, 2026. This move represents a debt-based capital raising exercise by the financial services firm. Retail investors should note this as a change in the company's capital structure and debt obligations.
why_it_matters: Debt issuance alters the company's interest burden and financial leverage.

headline: Akme Fintrade issues Rs 500 crore in non-convertible debentures
hook: Akme Fintrade raises Rs 500 crore via NCDs
summary: Akme Fintrade (India) Limited has announced the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) totaling Rs 50 crore. This debt instrument issuance is a standard corporate financing activity to raise capital. The company informed the NSE of this development through an official regulatory filing.
why_it_matters: Company debt levels increase to fund operational or expansion plans.

headline: AFIL receives trading approval for 1.3 crore converted shares
summary: AFIL has received trading approval from the NSE for 1.3 crore equity shares. These shares were issued following the conversion of warrants allotted on a preferential basis. The shares have a face value of Rs 1 each. This increases the total number of tradable shares for the company.
why_it_matters: Increased share supply may impact short-term liquidity and price action.
